title: Reduce axioms in the CH independence gallery proof

problemStatement.formal: \operatorname{Con}(\mathrm{ZFC}) \to \operatorname{Con}(\mathrm{ZFC}+\mathrm{CH}) \quad\text{and}\quad \operatorname{Con}(\mathrm{ZFC}) \to \operatorname{Con}(\mathrm{ZFC}+\neg\mathrm{CH});\ \text{reduce the four Lean assumptions currently used for this gallery proof.}
problemStatement.plain: The gallery proof `ContinuumHypothesis.lean` already presents CH independence by axiomatizing Godel's constructible-universe side and Cohen's forcing side. This research problem asks whether any of its four remaining assumptions can be derived from Mathlib set-theory infrastructure, or whether the abstract model structures can be tightened without pretending to re-prove independence from scratch.
whyMatters: CH independence is a central result of modern set theory, and reducing the gallery axiom surface would make the formalization more honest and useful.
The task clarifies exactly which constructible-universe and forcing ingredients are missing from the current Lean development.
Even a partial reduction would improve the surrounding cardinal, ordinal, and model-theory infrastructure for later foundations work.

proven: `ContinuumHypothesis.lean` is recorded locally as 396 lines with 0 sorries and 4 axioms.
The parent proof already uses Mathlib cardinal/ordinal infrastructure, including Cardinal, Ordinal, Aleph, and Cardinal.continuum.
Related open-question work reduced the CH-independence axiom surface before this task; this slug starts from the remaining four assumptions.
open: Whether `L_exists` can be derived from the available Mathlib set-theory axioms.
Whether `L_satisfies_CH` can be proved using existing ordinal/cardinal machinery.
Whether a usable forcing or generic-extension framework already exists locally or in Mathlib.
Whether `ConstructibleUniverse` and `ForcingExtension` can be made more concrete without adding a full forcing development.
knownResults.goal: Reduce the four current gallery assumptions toward zero where Mathlib supports it, or document the precise constructible-universe and forcing infrastructure gaps that block further discharge.
